build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping features to classes for a CRF model
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss by composing feature and transition graphs and scoring them
